headline: Energy and Health Care Maintain Dominant Leadership While Industrials Deteriorate and Emerging Regions Shift
market_regime: Divergent Sector Leadership with Commodity and Defensive Outperformance
executive_summary: The rotation landscape shows sustained strength in Energy (XOP, IXC, XLE) and Health Care (XPH, XBI, XLV), both exhibiting high rotation scores and positive multi-horizon relative performance. Emerging momentum is building in Latin America broad exposures and Brazil (EWZ), alongside sub-sector improvement in Health Care Providers (IHF). Conversely, Industrials (XLI, ITA) and Eurozone equities (FEZ) have suffered sharp score deteriorations into 63-bar score lows. Material intra-sector divergences in Communication Services, Materials, and Real Estate, alongside style pair tensions in Large Value vs Growth (IWD vs IWF), highlight conflicting signals between short-term momentum and longer-term relative trends.

Sector Divergence in Real Estate: Mortgage Real Estate (REM) registered a 20-bar score improvement of +21.89, while U.S. Equity Real Estate (XLRE) suffered a 20-bar score deterioration of -22.73.

methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
